props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the value to the right of the label: the percentage, or `valueText` when set.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Replaces the percentage, e.g. "7.2 GiB of 10 GiB". Also read by screen readers.

props.name: color
props.description: Bar colour. `auto` is for quotas: primary, then warning from 80% and danger from 95%.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: For work of unknown length: a sliding bar with no value.

props.name: size
props.description: Bar height: `small` 4px, `normal` 6px, `large` 10px.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing before emitting `search`. `0` emits on every key.

props.name: size
props.description: `small` 32px or `normal` 36px tall.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The search text.

props.name: title
props.description: Section title.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title.

props.name: backButton
props.description: Shows a back button that emits `back`.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Lets people collapse the body with a chevron button.

props.name: padded
props.description: Pads the body. Turn off for flush tables and lists.

props.name: plain
props.description: Drops the card surface so the section blends into its parent.

props.name: tone
props.description: `danger` draws a red border and title, for irreversible actions like deleting a database.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the body is shown. Bind with `v-model:open`.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Replaces the title area.

slots.name: title-extra
slots.description: Next to the title, e.g. a badge.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons on the right of the header.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Section body.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, 2–5 of them: `{ value, label, icon?, disabled? }`. Plain strings are accepted too.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, e.g. "Chart range". Required when nothing nearby labels it.

props.name: size
props.description: Height: `small` 28px (toolbars, cards) or `normal` 32px.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Shows only the icons; each option's `label` becomes its accessible name and hover title.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches to fill the row with equal-width segments.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every segment.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The selected option's `value`.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices: `{ value, label, description?, disabled?, group? }`.

props.name: label
props.description: Floating label. It rests inside the field and rises when a value is chosen or the list opens.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown in the field when there's no label and nothing is selected.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several values; `v-model` becomes an array.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Adds a search box to the list. Emits `search` so you can load options from an API.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button when a value is selected.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and blocks the field while options load.

props.name: refreshable
props.description: Shows a refresh button that emits `refresh`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and adds a red asterisk.

props.name: errorMsg
props.description: Error text under the field.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field (hidden while `errorMsg` is set).

props.name: size
props.description: `compact` 32px (toolbars and filters, no label), `small` 36px (forms) or `normal` 40px.

props.name: noResultText
props.description: Text shown when no option matches the search.

slots.name: option
slots.type: { option: SelectOption<V>; selected: boolean; active: boolean; }
slots.description: Custom option row. Receives the option and whether it's selected or highlighted.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Content shown when the list is empty or nothing matches.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the panel.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional line under the title.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the panel slides in from.

props.name: size
props.description: Width: `small` 400px, `normal` 520px, `large` 800px, `full` the whole viewport. Phones always get the full width.

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows the close button and allows Escape to close. Turn off while a required action runs. Old `disable-modal-close` inverted.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Closes when the backdrop is clicked. Old `ignore-outside-click` inverted.

props.name: hideFooter
props.description: Hides the footer bar. Old `hide-action-footer`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the panel is open. Bind with `v-model:open`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Panel body. Scrolls when it's taller than the viewport. Old `#custom-message`.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Replaces the title and description.

slots.name: header-actions
slots.description: Buttons next to the close button, e.g. a docs link.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Right-aligned footer buttons: Cancel, then the primary action. Old `#footer-button`.

slots.name: footer-left
slots.description: Left side of the footer, e.g. a status line.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: dark
props.description: Dark sidebar on `bg-sidebar` in both themes, like the old library's default look. Everything inside uses the dark tokens.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Shows a Collapse button at the bottom that toggles `v-model:collapsed`. It's hidden in the mobile drawer.

props.name: contained
props.description: Keeps the sidebar inside its parent instead of the viewport: the mobile drawer and backdrop use `absolute`, and the mobile layout follows the parent's width. Give the parent `relative`, `overflow-hidden` and a height. For previews and embedded shells.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: Width in px below which the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer: the window's width, or the parent's with `contained`. `0` keeps it docked.

props.name: top
props.description: Offset from the top of the viewport on desktop, e.g. `"56px"` under a full-width navbar. The height shrinks to match.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Icon-only 56px rail on desktop. Bind with `v-model:collapsed`.

props.name: mobileOpen
props.description: Whether the off-canvas drawer is open (below `breakpoint`). Bind with `v-model:mobile-open`.

slots.name: header
slots.description: The 56px top bar: logo or cluster switcher. Receives `collapsed` so you can show a small logo in the rail.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Sections (`AcSidebarSection`) and items (`AcSidebarItem`). Rendered inside a list.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Items pinned to the bottom, such as Help. Rendered inside a list, above the Collapse button.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the item. In the collapsed rail it becomes the tooltip and the accessible name.

props.name: icon
props.description: A Lucide icon component, e.g. `:icon="Database"`. The collapsed rail shows only the icon.

props.name: to
props.description: Route to link to. Renders `RouterLink` when vue-router is installed in the app, otherwise a plain link (string routes only).

props.name: href
props.description: Plain URL, for pages outside the app. Takes over from `to` when vue-router isn't installed.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current page: highlighted and `aria-current="page"`. With `to` and vue-router, an exact route match does this for you.

props.name: badge
props.description: A count or short word after the label, e.g. `3` or `"New"`. Shown as a dot in the collapsed rail.

props.name: badgeColor
props.description: Colour of the badge.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greys the item out and blocks clicks.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the nested items are shown. Opens by itself when a nested item is the current page. Bind with `v-model:open`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Nested `AcSidebarItem`s. Turns this item into a group that expands and collapses.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A custom 16px icon, e.g. an `` from the AppsCode CDN. Replaces `icon`.

props.name: label
props.description: Small uppercase heading above the items. Hidden in the collapsed rail, where a divider takes its place.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Turns the heading into a button that shows and hides the items.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the items are shown when `collapsible`. Bind with `v-model:open`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The section's `AcSidebarItem`s.

props.name: shape
props.description: `text` lines, a `circle` or `rect`, or a preset: `table`, `card`, `info-card`, `editor`.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines. The last one is shorter so the block reads as a paragraph.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows of the `table` preset, not counting the header.

props.name: cols
props.description: Columns of the `table` preset.

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width, e.g. `"80%"` or `"240px"`. Defaults to full width, or to `height` for a circle.

props.name: height
props.description: CSS height of a `rect` or `editor` (default `320px`, like AcCodeEditor), the diameter of a `circle`, or the height of each `text` line.

props.name: label
props.description: Hidden text for screen readers. Pass an empty string to hide the skeleton from them, e.g. when several are composed inside one `aria-busy` region.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter: `xs` 12px, `small` 16px, `normal` 20px, `large` 32px.

props.name: label
props.description: Read by screen readers. Pass an empty string when a visible label sits next to it.

props.name: options
props.description: The steps: `{ id, title, description? }`, with ids 1…n in order.

props.name: active
props.description: Id of the current step. Lower ids show a check mark.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown to the left of the switch.

props.name: name
props.description: Native `name` attribute.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch.

props.name: errorMsg
props.description: Error text under the switch.

slots.name: left
slots.description: Content before the label.

slots.name: middle
slots.description: Content between the label and the switch, e.g. an info icon.

slots.name: right
slots.description: Content after the switch, e.g. a status badge.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions: `{ key, label, sortable?, align?, width? }`.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row objects. Each column's `key` is read from the row.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Row property used as the Vue `key`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows instead of data.

props.name: loaderRows
props.description: Number of skeleton rows while loading.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text shown when `rows` is empty (or use the `empty` slot).

props.name: clickable
props.description: Adds a pointer cursor and emits `row-click`.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Content shown when `rows` is empty.

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs: `{ key, label, count?, disabled? }`. `v-model` holds the active `key`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Panel content, rendered under the tab list. Receives the active key.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the tag. The default slot overrides it.

props.name: color
props.description: `neutral` for most labels; a tone to group filters by kind, e.g. environment or region.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Pill shape (`rounded-50`) instead of the 6px control radius.

props.name: removable
props.description: Shows a remove button that emits `remove`.

props.name: keyLabel
props.description: Key of a key–value tag such as a Kubernetes label (`app=postgres`). Setting it switches to the two-part style.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Value of a key–value tag. Shown after `keyLabel`, tinted with `color`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Tag content. Replaces `label`, or the value in key–value mode.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A 14px icon before the text, e.g. a cloud provider or resource kind.

props.name: label
props.description: Floating label. It rests on the first line and rises on focus or when filled.

props.name: name
props.description: Native `name` attribute.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible height in lines. With `autoResize` it's the starting (minimum) height.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grows the field with its content instead of showing a scrollbar.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: With `autoResize`, the height in lines after which the field scrolls. `0` means no limit.

props.name: maxlength
props.description: Maximum number of characters. Shows a live `12 / 500` count under the field.

props.name: mono
props.description: Monospace text, for certificates, keys, YAML and other pasted config.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and adds a red asterisk.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Read-only field with a gray background.

props.name: errorMsg
props.description: Error text under the field. Turns the border and label red and sets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field (hidden while `errorMsg` is set).

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: Used until the viewer picks a mode.

props.name: display
props.description: `icons` is a compact 3-icon switch; `labels` adds the words, for menus and settings pages.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner of the screen. On phones (under 640px) toasts span the width at the same top or bottom edge.

props.name: max
props.description: How many toasts show at once (phones show at most 3). Newer ones queue behind and their timers wait until they're shown.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the notification region.

props.name: content
props.description: The hint text. Keep it to a few words; use the `content` slot for richer text.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side of the trigger. It flips to the opposite side when there isn't room.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait on hover before showing. Keyboard focus shows it immediately.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the tooltip off, e.g. while a menu from the same button is open.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The trigger: a button, icon button, link or any focusable element. It gets `aria-describedby`.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Tooltip content instead of the `content` prop. Text only; no links or buttons, since it can't be reached by Tab.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name or username. The avatar shows its initials.

props.name: email
props.description: Second line in the menu header, usually the email address.

props.name: avatarUrl
props.description: Profile photo. Falls back to initials when it's missing or fails to load.

props.name: profileUrl
props.description: Makes the menu header a link to the profile page.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows between the header and Sign out: `{ label, icon?, to?, href?, disabled? }`. Emits `select`. Use the default slot for anything custom.

props.name: showThemeMode
props.description: Adds the Light / Dark / System switch (`AcThemeMode`).

props.name: showName
props.description: Shows the name next to the avatar in the trigger (from 640px up).

props.name: logoutUrl
props.description: Makes Sign out a link to this URL, e.g. `${accountsDomain}/user/logout`. `logout` is emitted either way.

props.name: logoutLabel
props.description: Text of the sign-out row.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is open. Bind with `v-model:open`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Custom rows after `items`. Give each focusable row `role="menuitem"`, `tabindex="-1"` and the `itemClass` classes; call `close()` after an action.
